headline: Markets closed for weekend; Finolex Cables cuts copper cable prices with Polycab and RR Kabel in focus.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Indian equity markets are closed today, Saturday, 21 November 2026, for the weekend.
Regular trading sessions will resume on Monday, 23 November 2026.
Finolex Cables reduced copper armoured cable prices by up to 6%.
Peers such as Polycab and RR Kabel are expected to potentially follow the price adjustment.
whatHappening: Finolex Cables announced a price cut of up to 6% on its copper armoured cable products.
Industry players Polycab India and RR Kabel may adjust their pricing in response to Finolex's move.
HSBC identified 19 Indian stocks that received earnings upgrades for FY27 along with target price updates.
PM Narendra Modi emphasized India's ability to break limits and unlock possibilities during an event at IIT Kharagpur.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November 2026.
Finolex Cables announced price cuts of up to 6% on copper armoured cables, which could prompt price revisions from Polycab and RR Kabel.
Meanwhile, HSBC highlighted 19 Indian equities that saw FY27 earnings upgrades.
